main_text.l: ולהצמיח Et ut germinare faciat, Job.38.27. Fut. יַצְמִיחַ Efficiam ut germinet, Psal.132.17. תַּצְמִיחַ Proferet, Gen.3. v.18. הַצְמִיחַ Efflorescat, Jesa.45.8.
צמח m. Germen, Jesa.4.2. Aff. תוֹצִיא צִמְחָהּ Producet germen suum, Jesa.61.11.
צמה f. Coma, Crines: Aff. צַמָּתֵךְ Crines tuos, Jesa.47.2. מִבְּעַד לְצַמָּתֵךְ Prae crine tuo, vel, Praeter crines tuos, Cantic.4.1.
צמים m. Horridus, q. Crinitum dicas, id est, Praedo, Latro, Job.5.5. Nam hi comam alere solent, & horridi incedere, scribit Rabbi Levi Gersom.
צמק Arescere, Flaccescere: Partic. שָׁדַיִם צמקים Ubera flaccida, Hos.9.14.
צמוקים m. Uvae passae, Massa uvarum passarum, à Flacciditate, 1.Sam.25.18.
צמר m. Lana, Levit.13.47. Aff. צַמְרִי Lanam meam, Hos.2.5.

צמרת Calamus, Surculus, Ramus summus, sic dictus quasi Lanuginosus, vel à צמר Amputavit, quòd ad infitionem amputari & avelli soleat, & ita ז & צ [?] permutantur: אֶת צַמַּרְתּוֹ Surculum summum, Ezech.17.3. Aff. צַמַּרְתּוֹ Calamus summus ejus, Ezech.31.3.

צמת Exscidit, Succidit: Praeter. צָמְתוּ Exscindunt, Thren.3.53. Niph. Praeter. נִצְמְתִּי Excisus sum, Job.23.17. נִצְמְתוּ Excisi sunt, Job.6.17. Pih. Praet. cum geminata primâ radicali, צִמְּתֻונִי Exscindunt me, Psal.88. v.17. צִמַּתְּנִי Succidit me, Psal.119.139. Hiph. Praet. הִצְמִיתָה Exscindis, Psalm.37.27. Partic. plural. מַצְמִיתַי Exscindentes me, Psalm.69.5.
צנח Defiliit, Infiliit, Infixus fuit: Fut. וַתִּצָּנַח בְּאֶרֶץ Et defixus fuit in terram, Jud.4.21. Chaldaeus, וּנְעַצַת[?]

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and some consonants are small and faint; points marked [?] are doubtful. The Hebrew in the entry for צמרת (the permutation letters) and the form in צמיתרת are uncertain. The Latin entry for צנח breaks off at the foot of the page and continues on the next. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout (Psal., Jesa., Exscidit, Efflorescat). The digitiser's line at the foot ("Digitized by Google") is omitted.
